title: Owner-intervention channel with recorded interventions
output_schema: command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json profile=council-owner-module (required: unit_id, artifact_paths[], spec_anchor, evidence[], test_ids[], negative_control_ids[], reviewer_verdict, residual_unknowns[])

evidence.claim: Every owner intervention in the final artifact carries origin=owner and origin_marker owner-origin:<owner_id>; participant turns do not.
The event-log prefix hash taken before pause/inject/resume equals the hash of that same prefix afterwards; prior turn texts are byte-identical.

negative_controls.description: Overwrite a prior participant payload after a prefix hash was taken; check_prefix must FIRE. The same check is silent on the unmodified log.

negative_controls.good_state_output: append of a new event is accepted

owner_sign_off.note: Catalog owner_approval_required=true. This block records the gate. The independent reviewer PASS does not and cannot grant owner sign-off. Production use of the channel on a live owner-gated council remains owner-gated. The module itself is implemented and probe-green.

residual_unknowns.claim: tools/council/kernel.py (IMP-0264) is not on this worktree. LiveCouncil is the intervention surface a future kernel must call; it does not itself own topology/round scheduling.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: After IMP-0264 delivers kernel.py, wire pause/inject/resume through LiveCouncil rather than a parallel write path and re-run prefix_hash across a kernel-driven round.

residual_unknowns.claim: tools/council/dissent.py (IMP-0312) is not on this worktree. inject_constraint records the constraint as an event; it does not by itself prove dissent survives later synthesis.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-run conservation of distinctive dissent strings after IMP-0312 lands, with an owner constraint injected mid-run.

residual_unknowns.claim: 11-COUNCIL-SPECIFICATION.md is not on this Linux tree; the channel is implemented from the catalog question_or_target and tests_required, not from a byte-identical spec file.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Diff KIND_* and origin_marker rules against the spec file when it is restored.
